{{a|Thick Fat}}{{tt|*|in Pokémon Adventures}} | location=[[Hoenn]] | epnum=AG020| numeps1=less than 1| firststagename=Makuhita| epname=Brave the Wave | prevonum=296| evolution=1| evo1num=297| firstevoep=AG020| firstevoname=Brave the Wave | current=[[Party|With Brawly]]| java1=[[Shin-ichiro Miki]]| java2=[[Unshō Ishizuka]]| enva1=[[Darren Dunstan]]| enva2=[[Maddie Blaustein]]| }} '''Brawly's Hariyama''' (Japanese: '''トウキのハリテヤマ''' ''Tōki's Hariteyama'') is [[Brawly]]'s main {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in all media he has appeared in; that is, in the {{pkmn|games}}, in {{pkmn|animation}}, and the ''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' {{pkmn|manga}}. In all media it is shown to have evolved from Makuhita. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== [[File:Hariyama Surfing.png|thumb|220px|left|Hariyama and Brawly surfing]] Hariyama was first seen as a Makuhita in ''[[AG020|Brave the Wave]]'', where it was surfing with Brawly, something they are both interested in. While they were surfing, Makuhita lost its footing and fell over but recovered quickly when they got back to shore. When {{TRT}} arrived to catch {{AP|Pikachu}}, Makuhita swam very quickly on its surfboard and caught up to Team Rocket, tackling them and rescuing Pikachu in the process. During the [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against Ash, Brawly sent it out after his {{p|Machop}} got defeated under the hands of [[Ash's Treecko]]. In the first part of their battle, Makuhita rolled over sideways every time it got hit by an attack, similar to what Machop did when battling [[Ash's Taillow]]. Makuhita's strength in power and skill caused it to hold off Treecko's excessive {{m|Pound}} attacks, gaining the upper hand. Makuhita [[Evolution|evolved]] into Hariyama when Treecko got up after it was hit by {{m|Seismic Toss}}. Treecko was no match for Hariyama as its Pound attack was rendered useless. With the massive power boost Hariyama gained via Evolution, Hariyama finished Treecko off easily with a powerful {{m|Knock Off}}, thus defeating {{Ash}}. After the battle, it was seen surfing again with Brawly. Hariyama was shown to have improved its footing skills when it evolved. [[File:AG031.png|thumb|220px|Hariyama battling Treecko]] In ''[[AG030|A Meditite Fight]]'', Hariyama stopped a falling rock caused by a big storm from crushing Brawly and {{ho|Shauna}}. After the storm subsided, Hariyama took on Team Rocket and single-handedly defeated them with {{m|Arm Thrust}}. During Ash's [[rematch]] against Brawly in ''[[AG031|Just One of the Geysers]]'', Brawly sent out Hariyama to handle {{AP|Corphish}} after the latter defeated Machop. Hariyama immediately attacked with Arm Thrust. Ash had his Corphish use {{m|Harden}} to take in the blows Hariyama was delivering in order for Hariyama to get tired. However, Hariyama was able to keep going despite all that. Next, Corphish dived underwater to surprise Hariyama with {{m|Crabhammer}} which worked. In the end, Hariyama took out Corphish with Seismic Toss, leaving Ash with Treecko. Unlike last time, Treecko used Pound on Hariyama's legs instead of Hariyama itself since the footing is usually Hariyama's weakness. After Hariyama got hit with more Pound attacks on its legs, it was not able to hit Treecko with {{m|Vital Throw}}. With both Pokémon getting tired, Treecko was able to finish off Hariyama during the final part of the battle with Treecko and Hariyama using Pound and Knock Off respectively, winning Ash the {{Badge|Knuckle}}. It reappeared in a flashback in ''[[AG075|Whiscash and Ash]]''. ====Personality and characteristics==== Because of its time surfing with Brawly in Dewford Island, Hariyama, both in its form as a Makuhita and Hariyama, had great endurance and stamina as seen in its debut when it quickly chased after {{TRT}} on its surfboard. ====Appearance==== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fighting color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{fighting color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fighting color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Makuhita|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Brawly Makuhita.png|220px]] |} ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fighting||Brawly {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 7}}|0=Hariyama Vital Throw|1=Hariyama Arm Thrust|2=Hariyama Seismic Toss|3=Hariyama Knock Off|4=Makuhita Vital Throw|5=Makuhita Arm Thrust|6=Makuhita Seismic Toss}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 7}}|0=Vital Throw|1=Arm Thrust|2=Seismic Toss|3=Knock Off|4=Vital Throw as a Makuhita|5=Arm Thrust as a Makuhita|6=Seismic Toss as a Makuhita}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Vital Throw|AG020|Brave the Wave}} {{anmov|fighting|Arm Thrust|AG020|Brave the Wave}} {{anmov|fighting|Seismic Toss|AG020|Brave the Wave}} {{anmov|dark|Knock Off|AG020|Brave the Wave}} {{anmov/f|fighting}} ===GOTCHA!=== Brawly's Makuhita briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== Makuhita—and, in rematches, Hariyama—is Brawly's main Pokémon in the games. II]]'' surfing with Brawly. The wave they were surfing on got larger and {{adv|Sapphire}} wanted to rescue them since they would have been sucked in the wave. She claimed that the large wave was caused by her Lorry's sneeze. However, the size of the wave was fine as Makuhita was being taught martial arts and was doing so by the use of surfing. Makuhita was sent out as the second Pokémon during Sapphire's Gym battle in ''[[PS195|Mashing Makuhita]]'' after {{p|Machop}}'s defeat in the hands of [[Chic]], Sapphire's newly evolved {{p|Combusken}}. Brawly trusted Makuhita in terms of strength. Its first opponent was [[Rono]], Sapphire's newly evolved {{p|Lairon}}. Makuhita had the huge advantage with type since Rono was part {{t|Steel}} and {{t|Rock}}. In the battle, Makuhita took advantage of its surfing techniques when it absorbed Rono's {{m|Metal Claw}} and {{m|Iron Tail}} simultaneously. Afterwards, Makuhita took out Rono with {{m|Counter}}, dealing double the damage to the Lairon. Makuhita's next opponent was Chic. Chic launched a {{m|Flamethrower}} at the rotund fighter and dealt very little damage due to its {{a|Thick Fat}} Ability. Afterwards, it dodged Chic's attack, landing the Young Fowl Pokémon slamming to a wall. As Makuhita was avoiding and flowing with Chic's attack strength, it gained energy. All that energy caused Makuhita to evolve into Hariyama. Hariyama was about to deliver the last attack until Chic used {{m|Double Kick}}, by having the first kick block Hariyama's attack and the second kick for offense. This strategy took out Hariyama, earning Sapphire the {{Badge|Knuckle}}. Hariyama reappears in ''[[PS244|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon VIII]]'', during the fight against {{p|Groudon}}. Brawly has Hariyama wake up {{p|Machoke}} after it got hit by the electricity in the air that Groudon absorbed. Hariyama battles with [[Blaise]] in ''[[PS247|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon IX]]''. It had no trouble handling Blaise's illusionary skills and his two illusion-producing {{p|Slugma}}, where one {{m|Fake Out}} startles them and leaves them wide open for another attack. Hariyama uses this opportunity to use {{m|Arm Thrust}} on them. The battle continued in the [[PS248|next chapter]] and ''[[PS250|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XII]]''. During the twelfth part of the Kyogre and Groudon battle, Hariyama defeats the two Slugma using the tactics Brawly learned from his old friend [[Bruno]]. After the battle, Hariyama, along with its Trainer, get exhausted since they spent most of their vitality countering Blaise's illusions, allowing Blaise to flee the [[Lilycove Museum]]. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== In ''[[PAORAS21|Omega Alpha Adventure 21]]'', Hariyama assisted in stopping the [[Grand Meteor Delta]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== While Hariyama was fighting [[Blaise]]'s {{p|Slugma}}, he was able to handle the illusions Blaise threw at him and Brawly unlike {{p|Machoke}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|fighting||Brawly Hariyama {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Counter|1=Fake Out|2=Arm Thrust|3=SmellingSalt|4=Knock Off}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Counter|1=Fake Out|2=Arm Thrust|3=Smelling Salts|4=Knock Off}}}} {{anmov|fighting|Counter|PS195|Mashing Makuhita}} {{anmov|normal|Smelling Salts|PS244|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon VIII|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Fake Out|PS247|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon IX|rec=yes}} {{anmov|fighting|Arm Thrust|PS247|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon IX|rec=yes}} {{anmov|dark|Knock Off|PS250|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XII|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|fighting}} ==Trivia== * Hariyama is the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the moves {{m|Smelling Salts}}, {{m|Fake Out}}, or {{m|Knock Off}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Makuhita|Hariyama}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Gym Leaders' Pokémon|Hariyama]] [[Category:Ruby and Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Emerald characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[es:Hariyama de Brawly/Marcial]] [[fr:Hariyama de Bastien]] [[it:Hariyama di Rudi]] [[zh:藤树的铁掌力士]]
